subject: Underage Alcohol Compliance Violations
overview: The commission approved several one-day licenses and manager amendments before holding disciplinary hearings for two establishments regarding police compliance check failures for serving alcohol to minors. The commission took both violation matters under advisement.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from the June 24, 2026, and September 16, 2026 meetings.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Medford Brewing
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for Medford Brewing Company for the Wright's Pond Pumpkin Extravaganza on October 24 and the Run Medford event on December 5.

items.title: Change of Manager: Pizzeria Regina
items.summary: Approved a change of manager application for Pizzeria Regina at 44 Station Landing.

items.title: Change of Manager: Medford Lodge of Elks
items.summary: Approved a change of manager application for the Medford Lodge of Elks at 19 Washington Street, naming Richard E. Elwood Jr. as manager.

items.title: One-Day License: Medford Historical Society
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for the Medford Historical Society's members-only Christmas party on December 3.

items.title: Disciplinary Hearing: Yoki Japanese Restaurant and Bar
items.summary: The commission held a hearing regarding an August 13 compliance check where an underage operative was served alcohol without being asked for identification, taking the matter under advisement after hearing testimony regarding staff retraining and TIPS certification.

items.title: Disciplinary Hearing: The Establishment
items.summary: The commission heard testimony regarding an August 13 compliance check failure at The Establishment at 175 Rivers Edge Drive and took the violation under advisement following the owner's explanation of employee discipline and updated ID policies.
